title: Cute little box, has many uses.
text:
Cute little box, has many uses.. I should have read the measurements better.
I thought this was going to be bigger!

Its a nice light gray, which I like.Fits into any color scheme.
The window in the front is sewed in plastic, which makes it nice to see in what ever you put in this little box.

I think this is good for putting in kids socks, women’s bra’s, belts, underwear, scarfs rolled up, a few skens of yarn,
sewing odds and ends, Kids little toys that get lost in there toy box..two pair of shoes,Crafts.
There really is allot of things you can store in here, or for the kiddo’s. But its not large.
There is no handle. The lid is attached in the back.

I do not think this is big enough for towels , linens, or sturdy enough. etc.
This is not for opening and closing on a regular bases.
Not sure how long this is going to hold up if it was used allot.!!!
